fields.name: ExcelApplication
fields.label: Excel Application
fields.description: The Excel Application object containing the workbook to save.

fields.name: SaveMode
fields.label: Save Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to save the workbook.

selectOptions.label: Save
selectOptions.description: Saves the active workbook in its current format.

selectOptions.label: Save a Copy
selectOptions.description: Saves the active workbook to a specified path with a chosen format.

fields.name: DocumentFormat
fields.label: Select Format
fields.description: The file format to save the workbook as. This is required when 'Save Mode' is set to 'Save a Copy'.

selectOptions.label: SYLK (Symbolic Link) (*.slk)
selectOptions.description: Saves as SYLK (Symbolic Link) (*.slk) for data exchange.

selectOptions.label: CSV (Comma delimited) (*.csv)
selectOptions.description: Saves as CSV (Comma delimited) (*.csv) format.

selectOptions.label: DIF (Data Interchange Format) (*.dif)
selectOptions.description: Saves as DIF (Data Interchange Format) (*.dif).

selectOptions.label: Excel 97-2003 Add-in (*.xla)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel 97-2003 Add-in (*.xla) for backward compatibility.

selectOptions.label: Text (Macintosh) (*.txt)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Text (Macintosh) (*.txt) with Macintosh line breaks.

selectOptions.label: Text (MS-DOS) (*.txt)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Text (MS-DOS) (*.txt) with MS-DOS line breaks.

selectOptions.label: CSV (Macintosh) (*.csv)
selectOptions.description: Saves as CSV (Macintosh) (*.csv) with Macintosh encoding.

selectOptions.label: CSV (MS-DOS) (*.csv)
selectOptions.description: Saves as CSV (MS-DOS) (*.csv) with MS-DOS encoding.

selectOptions.label: Formatted Text (Space delimited) (*.prn)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Formatted Text (Space delimited) (*.prn).

selectOptions.label: Microsoft Excel 5.0/95 Workbook (*.xls)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Microsoft Excel 5.0/95 Workbook (*.xls).

selectOptions.label: Unicode Text (*.txt)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Unicode Text (*.txt) with full character set support.

selectOptions.label: Excel 97-2003 Workbook (*.xls)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel 97-2003 Workbook (*.xls) for backward compatibility.

selectOptions.label: Web Page (*.htm;*.html)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Web Page (*.htm;*.html) with table-based layout.

selectOptions.label: Single File Web Page (*.mht;*.mhtml)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Single File Web Page (*.mht;*.mhtml) containing all content.

selectOptions.label: XML Spreadsheet 2003 (*.xml)
selectOptions.description: Saves as XML Spreadsheet 2003 (*.xml) for structured data transfer.

selectOptions.label: Excel Binary Workbook (*.xlsb)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel Binary Workbook (*.xlsb) optimized for performance.

selectOptions.label: Excel Workbook (*.xlsx)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel Workbook (*.xlsx), the default modern Excel format.

selectOptions.label: Excel Macro-Enabled Workbook (*.xlsm)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel Macro-Enabled Workbook (*.xlsm) with macro support.

selectOptions.label: Excel Macro-Enabled Template (*.xltm)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel Macro-Enabled Template (*.xltm) with macro support.

selectOptions.label: Excel Template (*.xltx)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel Template (*.xltx) without macro support.

selectOptions.label: Excel Add-in (*.xlam)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel Add-in (*.xlam) with macro support.

selectOptions.label: Excel 97-2003 Template (*.xlt)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Excel 97-2003 Template (*.xlt) for backward compatibility.

selectOptions.label: OpenDocument Spreadsheet (*.ods)
selectOptions.description: Saves as OpenDocument Spreadsheet (*.ods) for LibreOffice/OpenOffice compatibility.

selectOptions.label: Strict Open XML Spreadsheet (*.xlsx)
selectOptions.description: Saves as Strict Open XML Spreadsheet (*.xlsx) compliant with standards.

fields.name: DocumentPath
fields.label: Document Path
fields.description: The file path to save the copy of the workbook. Extension will be determined by the selected format and will be ignored if already present in the path
